name: Foreign Employee Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: A sponsoring Iranian employer must apply to the Ministry of Cooperatives, Labour and Social Welfare, demonstrating a genuine need to hire the foreign national and submitting company registration documents and an employment contract; the employer runs the application on the worker's behalf.
requirements.fix_path: Secure sponsorship from an Iranian-registered employer willing to file the work permit application.

requirements.blocker_text: The Ministry conducts a labor market test to confirm no qualified Iranian citizen is available for the role before approving employment of a foreign national.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable based on the employment contract

sources.title: Rivermate (private global-employment/EOR guide) -- Iran work permits issued by the Ministry of Cooperatives, Labour and Social Welfare; requires employer sponsorship, a labor-market test showing no qualified Iranian citizen is available, company registration and employment-contract documents; permit typically valid 1 year, renewable; processing roughly 2-4 months
